'''Nik Sant''', or '''"Gramps"''' as he was affectionately known, was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and survival expert of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] sent to the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Biography==
===Galactic Civil War===
Nik Sant, along with the famous wilderness guide [[Greeve (Human)|Greeve]], worked as survival experts in the jungles of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] prior to their recruitment by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].<ref name="Fact" />

Sant was a leading member of a group of soldiers who, in the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], devised plans for the Rebellion's guerrilla-like attacks and key targets in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

[[File:NikSant.png|thumb|left|120px|Sant landing on Endor.]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] he helped assemble and joined a strike team under the command of General [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], as its oldest member, with the goal to destroy the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] on Endor, in order to allow the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to destroy the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. He, along with the rest of the team, landed on Endor and joined forces with the forest moon's [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribes, who agreed to help them.<ref name="Episode VI" />

The strike team was lead to the back entrance of the shield generator bunker, where four Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] stood guard. When an Ewok, [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] stole a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], three of the scout troopers followed, leaving only one at the shield generator. The Rebels captured the trooper and Sant disguised himself in his armor, taking up the trooper's post while the rest of the strike team entered the bunker. However, as part of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] plan, more Imperial troops, who had been expecting them, arrived and captured the Rebels, including Sant, whose disguise they saw through. Not long after they were captured, however, the Ewoks ambushed the Imperials, starting the ground battle proper.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Personality and traits==
Nik Sant had a short, bushy white beard. He was a lieutenant of the Endor strike team and a survival specialist.

==Equipment==
During his service with the Endor strike team, Nik Sant wore the forest camouflage gear of the team's members. He was armed with an [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster]] rifle and a military [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nik Sant appeared briefly as a member of Han Solo's strike team in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> He was first identified as Nik Sant in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 44]] in [[2002]].<ref name="Fact">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 44]]</ref> According to a continuity polaroid from ''Return of the Jedi'', he was portrayed by one "L. Burner."<ref name="SWA">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsarchives.com/dt_gallery/1983-continuity-polaroids|text=Return of the Jedi continuity polaroids|work=Star Wars Archives|archivedate=20180314171407}}</ref>
